paragraphs: The scale of a cycle places the familiar events of recent history in a much wider perspective. The stated minimum is a horizon of at least 500,000 years; it does not give a date on which the cycle will end.
The full-cycle view keeps a linear scale. Recorded history is consequently a very small part of that view. Use “Recorded history” to move into the events we can explore in detail.

quote.text: at least five hundred thousand years
